description: Labelled model proposals used to measure the finding validator. Each proposal states the outcome ReviewForge must produce for the supplied commit context.

proposals.label: real defect on changed lines with verbatim evidence
proposals.title: Check-then-act race can oversell inventory
proposals.explanation: Availability is checked and then acted on without holding a lock.
proposals.failureScenario: Two threads reserve the last unit concurrently and both succeed.
proposals.suggestedFix: Reserve atomically and check the result.

proposals.label: evidence quoted from a line the model never saw
proposals.title: Quantity is never validated
proposals.explanation: Claims a guard that does not exist.

proposals.label: defect reported on an untouched line
proposals.title: Package declaration should be lowercase
proposals.explanation: Points at code this pull request did not change.

proposals.label: line range past the end of the analyzed revision
proposals.title: Resource is never closed
proposals.explanation: Refers to lines that do not exist at this commit.

proposals.label: file that was never supplied to the model
proposals.title: Credentials written to the log
proposals.explanation: Names a file outside the analysis context.
proposals.failureScenario: Secrets end up in log aggregation.

proposals.label: confidence below the configured floor
proposals.title: Reservation may be slow under contention

proposals.label: category outside the supported taxonomy
proposals.title: Braces should be on the same line

proposals.label: real nullable dereference on an added line
proposals.title: Nullable tier is dereferenced without a guard
proposals.explanation: A customer without a tier produces a NullPointerException.
proposals.failureScenario: A newly registered customer has no tier and pricing fails.
proposals.suggestedFix: Return the default discount when the tier is absent.

proposals.label: identical repeat of an accepted finding
proposals.title: Nullable tier is dereferenced without a guard
